SELECT pi.invoice_id, pi.invoice_code, pi.shop_id, pi.shop_name, pi.staff_name, pi.table_number, pi.total_amount, pi.created_at, id.invoice_detail_id, id.drink_detail_id, dd.drink_id, d.drink_name, dd.size, id.quantity, id.unit_price, (id.unit_price * id.quantity) AS item_total, id.note
FROM ( SELECT i.invoice_id, i.invoice_code, i.shop_id, s.shop_name, p.full_name AS staff_name, st.table_number, i.total_amount, i.created_at FROM invoices i JOIN shops s ON i.shop_id = s.shop_id LEFT JOIN profiles p ON i.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN shop_tables st ON st.table_id = i.table_id
ORDER BY
i.invoice_id s.shop_name p.full_name st.table_number i.total_amount i.created_at
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ) pi
LEFT JOIN invoice_details id ON pi.invoice_id = id.invoice_id AND id.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN drink_details dd ON id.drink_detail_id = dd.drink_detail_id LEFT JOIN drinks d ON dd.drink_id = d.drink_id
ORDER BY
pi.invoice_id pi.shop_name pi.staff_name pi.table_number pi.total_amount pi.created_at
ASC DESC , id.invoice_detail_id ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.total_amount), 0) FROM invoices i JOIN shops s ON i.shop_id = s.shop_id LEFT JOIN profiles p ON i.profile_id = p.profile_id LEFT JOIN shop_tables st ON st.table_id = i.table_id
